## Lane completion vocabulary

These are aggregate stage requirements; skipping one role never removes an entire stage. L4 adds retro when analyst is invited. Legacy v3 omits accept.

- L0: none
- L1: implement, review
- L2-default: define, shape, implement, verify, accept, review
- L2-short: define, implement, verify, accept, review
- L3: define, shape, implement, verify, accept, review, qc, deliver
- L4: define, shape, implement, verify, accept, review, qc, deliver

- architect: architecture.md
